couplets.en: Come, let us make our plea to life, our beloved.
May tomorrow lend its sweetness to the poison of today.
Some have no strength left to bear the weight of the days.

lines: Unki palkon pe shab-o-roz ko halka kar de
couplets.en: May the days and nights rest lightly on their eyelids.

lines: Jinki aankhon ko rukh-e-subh ka yaara bhi nahin
couplets.en: Some can scarcely bear to look upon the face of dawn.

lines: Unki raaton mein koi sham'a munawwar kar de
couplets.en: May a candle be lit in their nights.

lines: Jinke qadmon ko kisi raah ka sahaara bhi nahin
couplets.en: Some have no road beneath their feet to carry them onward.

lines: Unki nazron pe koi raah ujaagar kar de
couplets.en: May a path come into view for them.
Some have made a creed of falsehood and pretense.
May they find the courage to disbelieve and the resolve to inquire.
Some wait for the sword of tyranny to fall.

lines: Dast-e-qatil ko jhatak dene ki taufeeq mile
couplets.en: May they find the strength to shake off the killer's hand.

lines: Ishq ka sirr-e-nihaan, jaan-e-tapaan hai jis se
couplets.en: Love keeps a secret that sets the soul aflame.

lines: Aaj iqraar karein aur tapish mit jaaye
couplets.en: Let us confess it today, and may the burning ease.

lines: Harf-e-haq dil mein khatakta hai jo kaante ki tarah
couplets.en: A word of truth pricks the heart like a thorn.

lines: Aaj izhaar karein aur khalish mit jaaye
couplets.en: Let us speak it today, and may the ache subside.
Come, let us raise our hands in prayer too.
